stdout:
usage: telemetry.py [-h] [--json] [--detail] [--since SINCE]
                    [--hosts HOSTS [HOSTS ...]] [--compare PR|REV|DATE]
                    [--window WINDOW] [--sync] [--add LABEL] [--at ISO]
                    {ingest,sources,stats,changes,retro,accepted}

Local, metadata-only provider usage ledger.

positional arguments:
  {ingest,sources,stats,changes,retro,accepted}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json
  --detail
  --since SINCE
  --hosts HOSTS [HOSTS ...]
                        all or configured host names (stats only)
  --compare PR|REV|DATE
                        before/after metrics around a change (stats only)
  --window WINDOW       each side of --compare, or retro compares: 24h, 7d, 2w
  --sync                read merged PRs with gh (changes only)
  --add LABEL           manual change marker (changes only; needs --at)
  --at ISO              time of a manual marker
